headline: Almaty Wednesday: Tsitsipas edges Kovacevic in three sets, Khachanov advances
whyCareReason: Tsitsipas saved three set points in an 11-9 first-set tiebreak. Khachanov dismissed Sakamoto 6-2, 6-4.
teaser: Tsitsipas d. Kovacevic 7-6(9), 3-6, 6-3 in two hours. Khachanov d. Sakamoto 6-2, 6-4. Duckworth tops Darderi.
story: Stefanos Tsitsipas fought past Aleksandar Kovacevic 7-6(9), 3-6, 6-3 in the first round of the Almaty Open on Wednesday, 21 October. Tsitsipas saved three set points in a high-tension opening-set tiebreak to avenge an earlier defeat at Winston-Salem. The match lasted two hours on the indoor hard courts in Kazakhstan. Fifth-seeded Karen Khachanov also advanced to the second round, firing past Japanese qualifier Rei Sakamoto 6-2, 6-4 in just over an hour without facing a break point. James Duckworth earned an upset over second seed Luciano Darderi 7-5, 7-6(7).
stakes: Tsitsipas and Khachanov advance to the round of 16 in Almaty as indoor season points heat up.
rivalryAngle: Tsitsipas responds to his Winston-Salem loss by denying Kovacevic in an 11-9 tiebreak.
funFacts: Tsitsipas saved three set points in the first-set tiebreak to take it 11-9.
Khachanov did not face a single break point in his 6-2, 6-4 victory over Sakamoto.
James Duckworth defeated No. 2 seed Luciano Darderi 7-5, 7-6(7).
